---
name: provenance-check
description: Check Ventura Algorithms explanations examples and references for accurate attribution and license boundaries. Use when adapting upstream educational material or implementation examples. Do not use when the change is an original summary with no external source dependency.
---

# Provenance check

- Identify external explanations diagrams code or problem statements used by the change.
- Distinguish mathematical ideas from copyrighted expression or copied implementation.
- Read `PROVENANCE.md` when present and keep it aligned.
- Preserve required attribution and license terms for derived examples.
- Prefer original explanations and minimal examples when copying is unnecessary.
- Remove unsupported affiliation or ownership implications.
